integrity: Analytical proof with reproducible finite numerical and Monte Carlo checks; no independent audit or independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Unbiased one-dimensional Brownian motion; one transparent inactive gate; finite positive rates and reset distance; no concurrent gate reinitialization. High-rate result is not uniform in reset distance. A general renewal-splitting theorem might imply portions of the result.
title: Exact directional capture probabilities for a transparent blinking Brownian target under resetting
